import BusyBeaver.ZFC
namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Binary153Audit
open BinaryPerm252 RuntimeInstancePerm252
#print axioms SitesPerm252.all_sites
#print axioms BinaryPerm252.blank_halts_iff_zf_refutation
#print axioms BinaryPerm252.nonhalting_iff_zf_consistency
#print axioms BinaryPerm252.blank_halts_iff_checked_refutation
#print axioms ZFCBoundPerm252.blank_nonhalting_of_zfc_consistent
#print axioms Code254ProofCompiler.refutation_cexec_none
#print axioms ConstructibleZF.L_models_ZF
example : BlankHalts machinePerm252 ↔ BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot :=
  blank_halts_iff_zf_refutation
example : (¬ BlankHalts machinePerm252) ↔ ¬ BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot :=
  nonhalting_iff_zf_consistency
example : BlankHalts machinePerm252 ↔ ∃ code, Code254Proof.check code Code254.F = true :=
  blank_halts_iff_checked_refutation
example (h : ¬ BProv LeanProofs.BoundedZFCConsistency.ZFCax_s [] Form.fBot) :
    ¬ BlankHalts machinePerm252 :=
  ZFCBoundPerm252.blank_nonhalting_of_zfc_consistent h
example (h : BProv PSCCalibration.ZF0Ax [] Form.fBot) : BlankHalts machinePerm252 :=
  ZFCBoundPerm252.blank_halts_of_zf0_refutation h
example (p : Code254Proof.RawProof) (hv : p.valid = true) (hf : p.conclusion = Code254.F) :
    Enum254.Halts := Code254ProofCompiler.refutation_halts p hv hf
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Binary153Audit
